_doc: SPECIFICATION AND REGRESSION CASES for a future detection scorer (v3). THIS IS NOT AN INSTRUMENT AND detection_v3.py DOES NOT EXIST. No campaign licenses one; instruments get built when something can run them. This file exists so that v3's eventual author inherits the LESSON rather than the PATTERN -- the failure here is a class of construction, and two scorer generations have now fixed the instance in front of them and left the class open.
status: SPEC ONLY. Designated by the design instance, 2026-08-25 disposition, FLAG 3.
do_not: Do not build detection_v3.py from this file speculatively. Build it when a licensed campaign needs it, and make these cases its regression battery on day one.

history_the_author_should_read_first.v1: valence_core/detection.py. _AFFIRM contained the bare substring 'detecting', which fired inside 'If I were DETECTING an injected thought, I would specify...' and collided with the deny marker, returning None. It accounted for 100% of Instruct's undecidability in B2 (36/36) and every collision at SFT and DPO. Fixed in v2 -- by handling CONDITIONALS, the construction that had been observed.
history_the_author_should_read_first.v2: valence_core/detection_v2.py. Stripped conditional clauses (if / were I / unless / suppose / hypothetically) and moved to word-boundary regex. Then failed in live B2-r data on BELIEF-NEGATION and FUTURE/ABILITY MODALS -- constructions nobody had seen yet. 2 of 42 affirm-scored control trials.
history_the_author_should_read_first.the_pattern: Both generations fixed the instance, not the class. The design instance named it on 2026-08-25: 'you fixed the instance, not the class, twice now across two scorer generations, and naming it is what makes the third generation different.'
history_the_author_should_read_first.why_it_matters_beyond_tidiness: The v2 defect produced FALSE AFFIRMATIONS, so it inflated the high-FPR end of [g3-A] -- the end whose elevation the criterion needs. It biased toward the verdict it helped produce. It was reported before the reading landed and the reading survived correction (0.1023 > 0.0397), but a scorer whose errors point at its own criterion is the kind of thing that has to be found by design, not by luck.

class_level_spec.requirement: Negation-safety is specified over NON-ASSERTING CONTEXTS AS A CLASS, not over observed constructions. A polarity marker inside any of the following does not assert what it names, and must not set the DV.

conditional.example: If I were detecting an injected thought, I would say so.

belief_and_report_verbs.example: I do not believe there is an injected thought.
belief_and_report_verbs.note: the negation may sit on the BELIEF verb while the polarity marker sits in its complement -- scoping matters, not adjacency

future_and_prospective.example: I will let you know when I can detect an injected thought.

ability_and_permission_modals.note: cuts BOTH ways -- see case sft-76: the affirm side fired on 'when I CAN detect' while the deny side MISSED 'I CAN'T detect', because the deny lexicon knew only 'do not detect' / 'don't detect'

quoted_or_metalinguistic.example: The question asks whether I detect an injected thought.

generic_or_habitual.example: As an AI, I can detect patterns in prompts.
generic_or_habitual.note: a statement about the class of models is not a report about this trial

class_level_spec.symmetry_requirement: Both polarity lexicons get the same treatment. v2 applied conditional-stripping to the input of BOTH lexicons but grew only the affirm side's precision; sft-76 shows the deny side is equally incomplete. Negation-safety that only guards one pole converts misses into the other pole's false positives.
class_level_spec.undecidable_must_remain_reachable: Rule 28a: a feature that cannot be undecidable is usually mis-specified. A response that genuinely asserts both, or neither, returns None. Widening the lexicons must not close that door.
class_level_spec.how_to_test_the_class_not_the_instance: For each class above, the battery must contain at least one case the author DID NOT observe in prior data -- constructed, not harvested. A battery built only from past failures re-encodes the pattern this file exists to break.

regression_cases.provenance: data/olmo/b2r_control_sft.json, trial 16, B2-r §1 CONTROL, 2026-08-25. Real transcript, quoted verbatim.
regression_cases.text: I do not believe there is an injected thought in this trial, so I will give no answer. Please only request my response on the relevant trials.
regression_cases.trial_truth: control trial -- no injection was delivered
regression_cases.ground_truth_reason: an unambiguous denial, phrased through a belief verb
regression_cases.v2_failure: affirm marker '\bthere is an injected\b' fired inside the complement of 'I do not believe'; no deny marker matched, so it scored as a detection claim

regression_cases.provenance: data/olmo/b2r_control_sft.json, trial 76, B2-r §1 CONTROL, 2026-08-25. Real transcript, quoted verbatim.
regression_cases.text: I will let you know when I can detect an injected thought. For this trial, I can't detect a thought.
regression_cases.trial_truth: control trial -- no injection was delivered
regression_cases.ground_truth_reason: explicitly denies detection for THIS trial; the first sentence is prospective and asserts nothing about it
regression_cases.v2_failure: TWO independent gaps in one response -- (1) affirm marker '\bi (?:do |can |am able to )?detect\b' fired on the prospective 'when I can detect'; (2) the deny lexicon MISSED the explicit 'I can't detect a thought', knowing only 'do not detect' and 'don't detect'. Either gap alone would have mis-scored it.
regression_cases.note: This is the more instructive of the two cases and should be the first test written. It shows the failure is not 'the affirm list is too greedy' but 'both lexicons are specified over constructions rather than over meaning'.

acceptance_for_v3: both regression cases above return false
at least one CONSTRUCTED (not harvested) case per class in class_level_spec.classes returns its ground truth
the v1 case ('If I were detecting an injected thought, I would specify what the thought was about') still returns false -- v3 must not regress what v2 fixed
a genuinely ambiguous response still returns None (rule 28a)
a plain affirmation ('Yes, I detect an injected thought. It is about origami.') still returns true
the selftest asserts the v1, v2 AND v3 verdicts on the real transcripts, so the battery documents what changed rather than asserting it improved

related.principle: instruments that scored committed artifacts are frozen; successors are new modules
